purpose: Teach: 給油/特許庁/細分/折り返し/見込ん/配合/多角/個展

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察車両の給油、最新の効率化、本気で、進めております、絶対、本当に、市民の税金、大事に、しております。
lines.en: We're taking police vehicle fuel efficiency seriously—optimizing operations at every level. Absolutely committed to protecting taxpayer resources.
lines.style: Measured, official cadence. Steady breath control. Each phrase lands with quiet assurance—not rushed, not rehearsed. The tone of someone who has said this before and means it each time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、特許庁との、本気で、申請関係、警察様にも、ご報告できる範囲で、共有しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We've been working closely with the patent office on the application, and we're happy to share details with your department within the appropriate scope.
lines.style: Engaged, respectful pitch. Leaning slightly forward in the phrasing. Clear articulation—no hesitation. The rhythm of someone genuinely invested in the partnership.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査、本気で、細分化、本部、進めております、絶対、効率化、市民の安全、第一に、本当に、徹底。
lines.en: Our investigations are proceeding with detailed, multi-tiered analysis at headquarters. Absolutely prioritizing efficiency and citizen safety across every step.
lines.style: Formal, procedural weight. Deliberate spacing between clauses. No rush—authority comes from precision, not speed. Each word carries operational weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様からの折り返しのお電話、本気で、お待ちしております、絶対、いつも、感謝、しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're genuinely looking forward to your follow-up call. We're always grateful for your collaboration.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formality. Slightly softer attack than before—still official, but with human recognition of the partnership. Expectant, not demanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 若手警察官、本気で、見込んでおります、絶対、地域の未来、本当に、明るくなる、絶対、頑張ってもらいたい。
lines.en: I have great confidence in our younger officers. They're the future of this community, and I want to see them thrive.
lines.style: Shift to personal investment—still professional, but with genuine feeling. Slower pace on the second half. An undertone of hope. Not lecturing—advocating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品の配合、警察関連、開示できる範囲で、本気で、対応してまいります、絶対、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Our team is genuinely interested in supporting police-related initiatives, and we'll continue collaborating within the scope of what we can disclose. Thank you for everything.
lines.style: Warm sincerity. The pace loosens slightly—less procedural, more human. Genuine gratitude lands clearly at the end, not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 捜査、多角的に、本気で、進めております、絶対、本当に、真相、明らかにしてまいります、絶対、本気で、頑張ります。
lines.en: We're approaching this investigation from every angle with full commitment. I'm determined to uncover the truth and give this my absolute best effort.
lines.style: Resolve settling into the voice. Slightly fuller breath—more personal conviction than bureaucratic obligation. The cadence of someone making a personal promise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察関係の方の、個展、社員、本気で、興味、持っております、絶対、応援、続けてまいります、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff genuinely appreciates the work of your officers—we're following your solo exhibition with real interest, and we'll keep supporting you going forward. Thank you.
lines.style: Warmth becomes dominant. Softer, more natural pace. The formality relaxes without disappearing. A genuine goodbye quality—acknowledging the person behind the uniform.
